To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

GPIb is present on all megakaryocytic stages, from the promegakaryblast to the mature megakaryocyte, that the molecule is composed of two chains and that the beta chain has the same mobility as in platelets.
megakaryocytes express on their membrane GPIb and that the biosynthesis of this receptor is similar to that of platelets.
GPIb is expressed in megakaryocytes at all stages of maturation; GPIb is synthesized and is composed of two chains as is the platelet GPIb; GPIb is associated with GPIX.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new suspension liquid culture method of human megakaryocyte isolation.
the expression of the platelet GPIb in cultured human megakayocytes.
the study of megakaryocyte differentiation and maturation and with the biosynthesis of platelet membrane glycoproteins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

GPIb is a two chain constituent of the platelets and megakaryocytes, that it is synthesized by the latter, that the beta chain is devoid of methionsine residues and that the beta chain of GPIb is associated with GPIX in megakaryocytes.

the GPIb/IX complex is synthesized in megakaryocytes, that it is expressed at the plasma membrane of megakaryocytes at all stages of maturation and that it is also expressed on demarcation membrane, but not on alpha granules.
GPIb is synthesized by megakaryocytes, is present in the plasma membrane of the whole megakaryocyte lineage, and that it associates with GPIX.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GPIb is synthesized by megakaryocytes as a disulfide-linked dimer and that the GPIb/ GPIX complex is expressed on the surface of megakaryocytes.
GPIb is a megakaryocyte lineage specific marker, which is expressed at the plasma membrane of megakaryoblast, and at the membrane of demarcation membrane system of maturing megkaryocytes.

GPIb is expressed in megakaryocytes from the earliest stages of maturation, that GPIb is synthesized as a precursor that is processed to the mature form, and that GPIb is associated with GPIX in megakaryocyte plasma membranes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
megakaryocytes are a valuable source for studying the biosynthesis and the intracellular localization of GPIb.

the expression of GPIb by megakaryocytes is similar to that of platelets.
